subject: How do I create an unconstrained model within a path model for a MGA?

messages.author: 5f52e5cf601c6c26
messages.subject: How do I create an unconstrained model within a path model for a MGA?
parts:
Hello everyone, 
so far I have a problem for which I have not found an answer here.
I have a SEM model with a path analysis and I want to do a MGA for this model.
The problem is, I don't achieve an unconstrained model (Configural Model) because the paths are automatically constrained by the model definition by labeling the paths. Is there a solution to circumvent this? 

Model: 
structuralmodel <- '
#Factors
riskper =~ Comorb + perSev + Comorb_An
behI =~ medi + test + impf
affR =~ distress_cent + psych_fin + ptsd
somR =~ dauer_cent+ LongCov + severity

#correlationen
test ~~ medi
Comorb ~~ impf
Comorb_An ~~ distress_cent
LongCov ~~ distress_cent
LongCov ~~ severity
medi ~~ severity
Comorb ~~ severity

#a path and b paths (mediator)  (this is problematic because the paths are not freely estimated between the groups)
riskper ~ aA* affR       # m on x1/a
riskper ~ aS* somR       # m on x2/a
behI ~ b* riskper        # y on m /b

#direct effect
 behI ~ cA*(affR)   #x1 on y /c

#indirect effect
aAb := aA*b     # x1 on y via m /ab
aSb := aS*b     # x2 on y via m /ab

#Total Effect
total1 := cA + (aA*b)
total2 := cS + (aS*b)
'

messages.author: 82889e926eb5165e
messages.subject: Re: How do I create an unconstrained model within a path model for a MGA?
parts:
when adding labels, you need to add as many labels as groups you have. Otherwise, you will be using the same label for every group

in the case of 2 you groups

riskper ~ c(aA1, aA2)* affR

messages.subject: Re: How do I create an unconstrained model within a path model for a MGA?
parts:
Thanks a lot for your answer !
I had meanwhile also found a thread about it and have adapted my model  https://groups.google.com/g/lavaan/c/o-dR3-ZOvwo/m/w-7HPk3-BAAJ
Unfortunately, my constructed paths are now no longer displayed and I got this error message: lavaanify(model = FLAT, constraints = constraints, varTable = lavdata@ov,  : lavaan ERROR: wrong number of arguments in modifier (aA1,aA2) of element riskper~affR
( I have 2 groups)

structuralmodel <- '
#Factors
riskper =~ Comorb + perSev + Comorb_An
behI =~ medi + test + impf
affR =~ distress_cent + psych_fin + ptsd
somR =~ dauer_cent+ LongCov + severity

#correlation

test ~~ medi
Comorb ~~ impf
Comorb_An ~~ distress_cent
LongCov ~~ distress_cent
LongCov ~~ severity
medi ~~ severity
Comorb ~~ severity

#a path and b paths (mediator)

riskper ~ c(aS1, aS2)* somR      
behI ~ c(b1, b2)* riskper        

#direct effect
behI ~ c(cA1, cA2)*affR   
behI ~ c(cS1, cS2)*somR  

#indirect effect / 
indA1 := aA1*b1    # group 1
indA2 := aA2*b2    # group 2  

indS1 := aS1*b1     # group 1
indS2 := aS2*b2     # group 2

#Total Effect  
totalA1 := cA1 + (aA1*b1)   # group 1
totalA2 := cA2 + (aA2+b2)   # group 2

totalS1 := cS1 + (aS1*b1)   # group1
totalS2 := cS2 + (aS2*b2)   # group2
'

when adding labels, you need to add as many labels as groups you have. Otherwise, you will be using the same label for every group

in the case of 2 you groups

riskper ~ c(aA1, aA2)* affR
